content:
maya: heads up — after the quota bump this morning we enabled the session eviction policy to free slots, seeing spike of 15% 5xxs on /v1/generate
arjun: which policy exactly? console or API toggle?
maya: console toggle — under Admin > Routing Policies we flipped `evict_inflight` on for the customer-tier rule set (was supposed to be a soft drain)
ken: oh. that flag currently triggers immediate eviction of in-flight KV caches for matching requests, not graceful drain. we discussed changing that but not shipped.
tina: are the errors timeouts or 500s? any pattern in the traces?
maya: mostly 502/504 from inference-proxy; traces show model shards failing to find KV; stack hints at mid-request cache invalidation
sre-oncall: rollback it. evicting in-flight is high-risk, especially on long-stream requests.
arjun: agree. we need to flip the flag off and re-run a canary with `drain=true` mode instead. who's on prod runbook?
maya: I'm on it. planning to call admin toggle via internal API so we can record audit. provisional command:

```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/policies/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"cust-tier-1","evict_inflight":false}'
```

maya: executing now
deploy-bot: user maya initiated policy toggle for cust-tier-1 at 2026-03-20T13:42:58Z, target: evict_inflight=false
deploy-bot: toggle completed, new_policy_state:{"evict_inflight":false,"drain_mode":"immediate"}
ken: wait seeing `drain_mode: immediate` — that's the problematic bit. the console changed the drain mode too?
maya: console UI has a dropdown but the API defaulted to "immediate" when we hit confirm. UI UX bug.
tina: immediate -> causes mid-request cache purge. we need a followup to require explicit drain selection and a preview of affected sessions
arjun: for the emergency, change drain_mode to `graceful` and set `drain_timeout` to 30s. command:

```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/policies/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"cust-tier-1","drain_mode":"graceful","drain_timeout_seconds":30}'
```

maya: applying that now
deploy-bot: user maya updated policy cust-tier-1: drain_mode=graceful, drain_timeout_seconds=30
sre-oncall: metrics look better already — 5xx back down to baseline, error budget healthy
ken: thanks — we need three action items: 1) immediate console UX patch to require explicit drain selection, 2) make `evict_inflight` default to false in API, 3) telemetry alert to detect sudden KV-miss rate increases
arjun: logging a shortticket: PLT-4829 with those three items and a deploy priority P1 for the UI patch
maya: adding to on-call postmortem and will attach the traces and the toggle audit
tina: can we make the toggle an opt-in canary: updates only apply to 1% of traffic for 5m before full roll? saves a lot of panic.
ken: that's a good improvement — routing policy rollout should support canary/gradual targets. add to PLT-4830
maya: thanks all. closing this thread but keeping the ticket open until UI shipped. :pray:
